experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day
experiences.description: Spend a full day at the iconic Magic Kingdom, home to Cinderella Castle, Space Mountain, and the beloved Festival of Fantasy parade. Arrive at rope drop (park opening) to maximize ride time before crowds build. With a late flight arrival on Day 1, plan this for Day 2 onward. Stay at a Disney on-site hotel like Disney's Contemporary Resort or Disney's Polynesian Village Resort — both are within walking distance or a short monorail ride to Magic Kingdom, eliminating transit time and letting you return for afternoon naps before evening fireworks.
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase, a living cultural and culinary journey through 11 countries including Mexico, Japan, France, and Morocco. Sample authentic dishes, watch live cultural performances, and browse artisan crafts. This is ideal for families who want entertainment and education combined. Stay at Disney's BoardWalk Inn or Disney's Beach Club Resort — both are within a short walk or boat ride to EPCOT's International Gateway entrance, saving significant travel time each day.
experiences.location: EPCOT, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
experiences.description: Immerse your family in the fully realized world of Star Wars at Galaxy's Edge, where you can pilot the Millennium Falcon, build a custom lightsaber, and encounter stormtroopers. Also enjoy Toy Story Land and the thrilling Tower of Terror. Book Lightning Lane passes in advance for top attractions. Disney's Art of Animation Resort and Disney's Pop Century Resort are directly connected to Hollywood Studios via the Disney Skyliner gondola system — a fun, fast, and free transit option that kids love.
experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening
experiences.description: Spend a relaxed evening at Disney Springs, Disney's free-admission shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or Rainforest Cafe, catch a live street performance, and browse Disney merchandise and unique shops. This is a perfect low-cost activity for Day 1 since your flight arrives after 20:00 — Disney Springs stays open until 11:00 PM and requires no park ticket. It's a great way to ease into the Disney experience without wasting a full park day.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Expedition & Pandora Experience
experiences.description: Explore Disney's Animal Kingdom, featuring the breathtaking Pandora – The World of Avatar with the Flight of Passage ride, a thrilling safari through Kilimanjaro Safaris, and live shows like Festival of the Lion King. This park is best experienced starting at morning rope drop when animals are most active. Disney's All-Star Resorts and Disney's Coronado Springs Resort offer affordable on-site stays with direct Disney bus service to Animal Kingdom, keeping your family close to the action throughout the week.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

trip_options.title: Budget Explorer - Disney World, Orlando, Florida
trip_options.description: Save money without sacrificing the experience. Perfect for travelers who value authentic local experiences over luxury.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway - Free Theme Park Shuttle
hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

day_by_day.morning: No activities - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities - flight arrives late night
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 via United Airlines. Collect luggage and take the Ramada Kissimmee Gateway free shuttle to the hotel (confirm shuttle schedule at the airport shuttle desk or call hotel ahead of time). Check in, unpack essentials, and review your Disney World park tickets and plans for the week. Download the My Disney Experience app if not already done.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or grab a snack at the airport
meals.lunch: On the plane or airport food court
meals.dinner: Grab a quick late-night bite at a nearby 24-hour Walmart Supercenter (1471 E Osceola Pkwy, Kissimmee) for snacks, drinks, and breakfast supplies — great budget move to stock up on room snacks and save money all week

day_by_day.notes: Stop at Walmart tonight to buy water bottles, snacks, granola bars, and easy breakfast items (cereal, fruit, juice) to keep in the room. This single shopping trip can save $50–$100+ over the week. Confirm the hotel shuttle schedule for Disney parks for the next morning.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to Magic Kingdom — aim to arrive at park opening (typically 9:00 AM). Head straight to Tomorrowland or Fantasyland to ride the most popular attractions before crowds build: Space Mountain, Big Thunder Mountain Railroad, and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Use the My Disney Experience app to grab Lightning Lane selections if included with your ticket.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Adventureland (Pirates of the Caribbean, Jungle Cruise) and Liberty Square (Haunted Mansion). Take a midday break during peak heat (12:00–2:00 PM) by enjoying indoor air-conditioned attractions or watching the Festival of Fantasy Parade. Refill your reusable water bottle at any quick-service location for free.
day_by_day.evening: Watch the iconic Disney Electrical Parade or Happily Ever After fireworks show (check the My Disney Experience app for exact times). Stay until park close to maximize your ticket value. Take the free hotel shuttle back.

meals.breakfast: Eat breakfast at the hotel using snacks purchased at Walmart (granola bars, fruit, juice) before heading out
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square — budget-friendly quick service with clam chowder, fish & chips, and sandwiches around $12–$15 per person
meals.dinner: Cosmic Ray's Starlight Café in Tomorrowland — one of Magic Kingdom's best value quick-service spots with burgers, chicken, and rotisserie options for $12–$16 per person

day_by_day.notes: Arrive at the park 30 minutes before official opening for 'rope drop' to beat the crowds. Free water is available at any quick-service counter — just ask. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen. June in Orlando is hot and humid with afternoon thunderstorms possible — pack a small poncho.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to EPCOT. Arrive at rope drop and head immediately to World Discovery to ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane required — set an alarm for 7:00 AM to grab a virtual queue spot). Then ride Test Track and Mission: SPACE.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore World Nature (Soarin' Around the World — a must-do!) and then stroll through World Showcase, which opens at 11:00 AM. Walk through the international pavilions (Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, UK, Canada) and enjoy free cultural entertainment, street performers, and exhibits. Norway's Frozen Ever After ride is a highlight.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's HARMONIOUS nighttime spectacular over World Showcase Lagoon — one of the largest nighttime shows Disney has ever created. Grab a spot around the lagoon 30–45 minutes early. Take the hotel shuttle back after the show.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast (Walmart snacks) before departure
meals.lunch: Sunshine Seasons in The Land pavilion — excellent value quick-service with rotating seasonal dishes, sandwiches, and Asian-inspired bowls for $12–$15
meals.dinner: Yorkshire County Fish Shop in the UK Pavilion — fish and chips for around $10–$12, one of EPCOT's best budget bites. Supplement with a snack from the Germany or Mexico pavilion

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is a walking-heavy park — the World Showcase loop is 1.2 miles. Wear comfortable shoes. The international pavilions offer free entertainment throughout the day. Check the My Disney Experience app for live entertainment schedules. Staying for the nighttime show maximizes your ticket value.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios. This park requires strategic planning — upon arrival, immediately join the virtual queue for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance (if still using virtual queues) or purchase Lightning Lane. Head to Toy Story Land first for Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Then experience Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run in Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge fully — browse the Marketplace, visit Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities (free to browse), and experience the immersive theming. Then head to Sunset Boulevard for Rock 'n' Roller Coaster and The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror. Catch a showing of Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (check app for times).
day_by_day.evening: Watch the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks and projection show — an incredible display over the Chinese Theatre. Also check if Fantasmic! is showing (evening lagoon show — arrive 45–60 minutes early for seating). Take the hotel shuttle back.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land — one of the most beloved quick-service spots with grilled cheese, BBQ brisket melts, and totchos (tater tot nachos) for $10–$14
meals.dinner: Backlot Express near Echo Lake — burgers, chicken strips, and sandwiches for $12–$15. Alternatively, grab a quick bite at Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge for a Star Wars-themed meal around $14–$17

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is the most attraction-dense park — plan your Lightning Lane selections carefully. The park can sell out of virtual queue spots within seconds of release (7:00 AM and 1:00 PM). Have the app open and ready. Fantasmic! dining packages exist but are not budget-friendly — arrive early for free general seating instead.

day_by_day.morning: Take the free hotel shuttle to Animal Kingdom. Arrive at rope drop and head directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar for Flight of Passage (the park's most popular ride — lines can exceed 2 hours by mid-morning). Then ride Na'vi River Journey. Explore the stunning Pandora landscape.
day_by_day.afternoon: Experience Kilimanjaro Safaris (best in the morning or late afternoon when animals are most active — if you missed morning, go now). Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for free wildlife viewing. Catch a showing of Finding Nemo: The Big Blue... and Beyond! at the Theater in the Wild. By 2:00–3:00 PM, head back to the hotel on the shuttle.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a relaxing evening at the Ramada hotel pool — a great way to cool off and rest tired feet. This is your budget recovery evening. Prepare snacks from your Walmart supplies for dinner in the room or walk to a nearby restaurant on US-192.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast before departure
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora — one of Disney's best quick-service restaurants with healthy grain bowls, noodle dishes, and protein options for $13–$17. Excellent value and quality.
meals.dinner: Denny's or IHOP on US-192 (within 1–2 miles of hotel) — budget-friendly family dining with meals from $8–$14. Or cook a simple meal in the room if you have a microwave/mini fridge.

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (typically 7:00–8:00 PM), so a half-day visit is very manageable. The afternoon pool break is strategic — it rests your body for the final two park days. Check if Rivers of Light nighttime show is operating (it has had on-and-off scheduling). Animal Kingdom is the most nature-focused park — great for families who love wildlife.

day_by_day.morning: Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely hotel breakfast. Take the free hotel shuttle to Disney Springs — Disney's free outdoor shopping, dining, and entertainment district (no park ticket required). Explore the World of Disney store (largest Disney merchandise store in the world), browse unique shops, and enjoy the lively atmosphere.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Disney Springs — visit the LEGO Store (free to browse with impressive LEGO sculptures outside), check out the NBA Experience building exterior, and enjoy street performers and live music. Browse the Marketplace Co-Op for unique Disney merchandise. Head back to the hotel by 3:00–4:00 PM to rest and freshen up.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for an evening session — if your ticket allows park hopping, or use this as a second full-day Magic Kingdom visit. Focus on any rides you missed on Day 2, or simply enjoy the magical nighttime atmosphere, Main Street U.S.A. lit up at night, and the fireworks again. Alternatively, enjoy the hotel area on US-192 — Old Town Kissimmee is nearby with free entertainment, classic car shows (Fridays), and carnival rides.

meals.breakfast: Hotel room breakfast (Walmart supplies)
meals.lunch: Disney Springs quick-service options — Chicken Guy! by Guy Fieri offers tenders and sandwiches for $12–$15. Or grab a snack from Amorette's Patisserie or Vivoli il Gelato for a treat
meals.dinner: Rainforest Café at Disney Springs (budget-friendly appetizers and kids meals) or walk to nearby Kissimmee restaurants — Perkins Restaurant & Bakery on US-192 offers hearty meals for $10–$15

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is completely free to enter and a great way to experience Disney magic without using a park ticket. Saturday is typically the busiest day at Disney Springs — go in the morning to avoid peak crowds. Old Town Kissimmee (5770 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy) is a short drive or rideshare from the hotel and offers free admission with affordable entertainment.

day_by_day.morning: Use this day as a flex day based on your flight home. If your flight is in the evening, revisit your favorite park for a few hours using the hotel shuttle. Alternatively, explore the International Drive area — visit the Orlando International Premium Outlets (4951 International Dr) for discounted Disney merchandise and souvenirs. Or visit the nearby Celebration, FL town (a Disney-planned community) for a free, charming stroll.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to the hotel, pack your bags, and check out. Store luggage with the front desk if needed. Take one last dip in the hotel pool. Pick up any remaining souvenirs at the Walmart on Osceola Pkwy — Disney-branded items are significantly cheaper here than in the parks. Arrange transportation to the airport (Uber/Lyft recommended — approximately $25–$35 to Orlando International Airport).
day_by_day.evening: Head to Orlando International Airport for your departure flight. Arrive at least 2 hours before domestic departure or 3 hours for international. Enjoy your final Florida meal at the airport or grab snacks from your remaining Walmart supplies.

meals.breakfast: Final hotel room breakfast using remaining Walmart supplies
meals.lunch: If visiting a park: quick-service of your choice. If staying local: Friendly's or Bob Evans on US-192 for a budget family meal ($10–$14 per person)
meals.dinner: Airport dining or pack snacks from Walmart for the flight home

day_by_day.notes: Budget Summary Tips for the Week: (1) Walmart grocery run on arrival night saves $50–$100+ on breakfasts and snacks. (2) Free hotel shuttle eliminates daily transportation costs to Disney parks. (3) Reusable water bottles filled at park quick-service counters (free) save $5–$10/day. (4) Quick-service dining over table-service saves $15–$30 per meal. (5) Disney Springs visit is completely free. (6) Staying just outside Disney property (Kissimmee) saves significantly on hotel costs vs. Disney resort hotels. Estimated daily food budget: $30–$50 per adult with smart planning.

day_by_day.morning: N/A – Flight arrives at 22:30. No morning or afternoon activities scheduled.
day_by_day.afternoon: N/A – In transit.
day_by_day.evening: Arrive at Orlando International Airport at 22:30 on Flight UA. Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle or a rideshare to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and settle into your room. Grab a light snack from a nearby 24-hour convenience store or the hotel vending area before getting a good night's rest.

meals.breakfast: On the plane or at the airport before departure
meals.lunch: On the plane or at the airport
meals.dinner: Late-night snack from hotel vending, a nearby 7-Eleven, or a quick drive-through such as McDonald's or Taco Bell on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy (open late)

day_by_day.notes: Keep Day 1 extremely light. Hydrate well after the flight. Lay out your park clothes and charge all devices tonight. Download the My Disney Experience app if you haven't already and confirm any Lightning Lane or dining reservations for the week. The hotel shuttle schedule should be confirmed at the front desk upon check-in.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park – Early Entry & Main Street USA. Catch the hotel's free theme park shuttle (typically departs ~7:30 AM). Arrive at Magic Kingdom for Early Theme Park Entry (30 minutes before official open for resort guests). Head straight to Fantasyland to ride Seven Dwarfs Mine Train and Peter Pan's Flight before crowds build. Then tackle Space Mountain and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue exploring Magic Kingdom. After lunch, experience the Haunted Mansion, Pirates of the Caribbean, and Tomorrowland attractions like TRON Lightcycle / Run (book Lightning Lane early via the app). Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel if needed – the free shuttle runs throughout the day – or find a shaded spot in Liberty Square to recharge.
day_by_day.evening: Return to Magic Kingdom for the evening spectacular. Watch the EPCOT Forever or Magic Kingdom's Happily Ever After fireworks show (check current schedule on the app). Enjoy the Festival of Fantasy Parade if timing aligns. Depart via the free hotel shuttle after the fireworks crowd thins slightly.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick breakfast at the hotel or pick up a pastry and coffee on Main Street USA at The Main Street Bakery (Starbucks-affiliated, mid-range pricing ~$8–$12 per person)
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House in Liberty Square – counter-service seafood and sandwiches, budget-friendly at ~$12–$16 per person
meals.dinner: Be Our Guest Restaurant (Beauty and the Beast themed) – book in advance via My Disney Experience; prix-fixe dinner ~$62 per adult, worth the splurge for one special meal

day_by_day.notes: This is your biggest, most iconic park day – pace yourselves. Wear comfortable shoes and bring sunscreen, a refillable water bottle, and a small backpack. June in Orlando is hot and humid (highs ~92°F/33°C) with afternoon thunderstorms common around 2–4 PM. Lightning Lane Multi Pass can be purchased in the app to skip standby lines for select attractions.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour – Morning at Future World / World Discovery. Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT. Start at World Discovery and World Nature sections: ride Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (book Individual Lightning Lane at 7 AM sharp via the app – it sells out fast) and Test Track. Then head to Soarin' Around the World for a breathtaking aerial experience.
day_by_day.afternoon: Transition to the World Showcase, which opens at 11 AM. Stroll through the 11 country pavilions – Mexico, Norway, China, Germany, Italy, America, Japan, Morocco, France, United Kingdom, and Canada. Sample signature snacks from each pavilion: a School Bread from Norway, a crepe from France, a Kakigori shaved ice from Japan, and a cheddar cheese soup in a bread bowl from Canada. This is the heart of the EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture experience.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for EPCOT's nighttime spectacular – EPCOT Forever (or the current show; check the app). Watch from the World Showcase Lagoon for the best views. Browse the unique artisan shops in the pavilions before heading back to the hotel via shuttle.

meals.breakfast: Kringla Bakeri og Kafé in the Norway Pavilion – try the School Bread and a coffee (~$10–$14)
meals.lunch: Graze through World Showcase snack stands as part of the cultural tour – budget ~$20–$25 per person for a 'snack lunch' across multiple countries
meals.dinner: Teppan Edo in the Japan Pavilion – hibachi-style teppanyaki dining, ~$35–$50 per adult; make reservations 60 days in advance via My Disney Experience

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT is the most walkable park – comfortable shoes are essential. The World Showcase loop is approximately 1.3 miles. If traveling with young children, the Norway Pavilion's Frozen Ever After ride is a must. Check for any EPCOT festivals happening during your visit (Food & Wine, Flower & Garden, etc.) as they add extra food booths and entertainment.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure – Morning Rush. Take the early hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios. Use Early Theme Park Entry to head directly to Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run first (shorter wait in the morning), then secure an Individual Lightning Lane for Rise of the Resistance – the most immersive attraction in all of Walt Disney World. Explore the land, interact with droids and stormtroopers, and visit Dok-Ondar's Den of Antiquities.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Hollywood Studios. Ride Slinky Dog Dash and Toy Story Mania in Toy Story Land. Then experience Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith in Sunset Boulevard. Catch a showing of Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular if the schedule aligns.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the nighttime shows at Hollywood Studios. Watch Fantasmic! (check showtimes – typically two shows on busy summer nights) and the Star Wars: A Galactic Spectacular fireworks display over the Chinese Theatre. These are among the best nighttime entertainment offerings at any Disney park.

meals.breakfast: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo in Galaxy's Edge – try the Ronto Roasters breakfast wrap (~$13–$15); very thematic and delicious
meals.lunch: Woody's Lunch Box in Toy Story Land – counter service with grilled cheese and totchos (~$12–$16 per person)
meals.dinner: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant – eat in retro drive-in cars watching classic sci-fi movie clips; ~$20–$35 per adult; book in advance

day_by_day.notes: Hollywood Studios is one of the most popular parks – arrive early and use Lightning Lane strategically. Galaxy's Edge is best experienced in the morning before crowds peak. The park can feel very crowded in June; use the My Disney Experience app to monitor wait times in real time and adjust your plan accordingly.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom – Pandora: The World of Avatar. Take the hotel shuttle to Animal Kingdom for Early Entry. Head immediately to Pandora – The World of Avatar and ride Avatar Flight of Passage (the most popular ride in the park – waits can exceed 2 hours; Early Entry is critical). Then ride Na'vi River Journey for a gentler, visually stunning experience through the bioluminescent rainforest.
day_by_day.afternoon: Explore the rest of Animal Kingdom. Take the Kilimanjaro Safaris for a genuine wildlife encounter with giraffes, elephants, lions, and more (best in the morning or late afternoon when animals are most active – try to squeeze in a second ride). Walk the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek. Ride Expedition Everest in Asia for a thrilling roller coaster experience.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Rivers of Light nighttime spectacular (check current show schedule) and the Tree of Life Awakenings – the Tree of Life comes alive with projected animal stories after dark. Enjoy the festive atmosphere of Discovery Island before heading back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Grab a quick bite at Starbucks (The Creature Comforts) near the park entrance or a snack cart on Discovery Island (~$8–$12)
meals.lunch: Satu'li Canteen in Pandora – the best counter-service restaurant in Animal Kingdom; customizable grain bowls and protein options ~$14–$18 per person
meals.dinner: Yak & Yeti Restaurant in Asia – pan-Asian cuisine in a beautifully themed setting; ~$20–$35 per adult; reservations recommended

day_by_day.notes: Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (typically 8–9 PM in summer). Plan your day accordingly. The park is very spread out and involves significant walking on uneven terrain. Bring insect repellent – the lush landscaping means more bugs, especially in the evening. Pandora is absolutely stunning at night with its bioluminescent glow.

day_by_day.morning: Rest & Resort Morning. Sleep in and enjoy a leisurely morning at the hotel. Take advantage of the hotel pool to cool off and recharge after four intense park days. This is a planned recovery day – your feet will thank you. Pack a light bag for the evening outing.
day_by_day.afternoon: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment – Afternoon Arrival. Take the hotel shuttle or a rideshare to Disney Springs (free admission, no park ticket required). Arrive around 1–2 PM to browse the shops at your leisure. Visit the LEGO Store, World of Disney (the largest Disney merchandise store in the world), and the unique boutiques in The Landing and Town Center districts. Check out the NBA Experience or Splitsville Luxury Lanes for optional paid entertainment.
day_by_day.evening: Enjoy a full Disney Springs evening of dining and entertainment. Watch street performers and live music acts throughout the complex. Browse the Marketplace and Marketplace Co-Op for unique souvenirs. The atmosphere is lively and festive on Saturday evenings with live entertainment stages.

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or a nearby IHOP / Denny's on W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy (~$10–$15 per person)
meals.lunch: D-Luxe Burger at Disney Springs – gourmet burgers with creative toppings, ~$15–$20 per person; great casual mid-range option
meals.dinner: The BOATHOUSE at Disney Springs – upscale waterfront dining with fresh seafood and steaks; ~$35–$55 per adult; make reservations in advance. Alternatively, STK Orlando for a more modern steakhouse experience at similar pricing

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and a great way to experience Disney magic without a park ticket. Parking is also free in the Disney Springs garages. Saturday evenings are busy – arrive by 1–2 PM to get the most out of the afternoon. This day is intentionally lighter to prevent burnout before your final park day.

day_by_day.morning: Revisit Your Favorite Park or Flex Day. Based on the week's experiences, choose your favorite park to revisit or tackle any missed attractions. Recommended: Return to Magic Kingdom for any rides you missed, or revisit EPCOT's World Showcase for pavilions you didn't fully explore. Alternatively, use this morning for a final hotel pool session and leisurely packing if you have an early departure.
day_by_day.afternoon: Final Souvenir Shopping & Relaxed Exploration. If revisiting a park, use the afternoon for a final ride on your favorite attraction and last-minute souvenir shopping. If departing, check out of the hotel and store luggage at the front desk while you enjoy a final few hours in the area. The nearby Old Town Kissimmee (5 minutes from the hotel) offers free admission with carnival rides, shops, and a classic car show on weekends.
day_by_day.evening: Farewell Dinner & Departure Prep. Enjoy a final dinner near the hotel or at Disney Springs. Return to the hotel, collect luggage, and prepare for departure. Confirm your return flight details and arrange transportation to the airport (hotel shuttle, rideshare, or rental car return).

meals.breakfast: Hotel breakfast or a final visit to a park's quick-service restaurant if heading to a park early
meals.lunch: Quick-service meal inside your chosen park (~$12–$18 per person) or a casual lunch at Perkins Restaurant & Bakery near Kissimmee (~$12–$16 per person)
meals.dinner: Celebration Town Tavern in nearby Celebration, FL (~10 min drive) – American comfort food in a charming lakeside town setting, ~$20–$35 per adult; a lovely low-key farewell dinner away from the tourist strip

day_by_day.notes: Use this final day to fill any gaps from the week – whether that's a ride you missed, a meal you wanted to try, or simply relaxing by the pool. Keep the evening low-key to avoid exhaustion before travel. Confirm your flight check-in online and set multiple alarms if you have an early morning departure. The hotel's free shuttle to the airport should be confirmed at the front desk the night before.

highlights: Mix of paid and free experiences

trip_options.title: Premium Disney World, Orlando, Florida Escape
trip_options.description: Indulge in the best the destination has to offer. Premium flights, luxury hotels, and exclusive experiences.

hotel.name: Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway - Free Theme Park Shuttle
hotel.location: 7470 W Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, Kissimmee, US (28.3314,-81.5863)

experiences.name: Magic Kingdom Park Full Day
experiences.description: Spend a full day at the iconic Magic Kingdom, home to Cinderella Castle, Space Mountain, and the beloved Festival of Fantasy parade. Arrive at rope drop (park opening) to maximize ride time before crowds build. With a late flight arrival on Day 1, plan this for Day 2 onward. Stay at a Disney on-site hotel like Disney's Contemporary Resort or Disney's Polynesian Village Resort — both are within walking distance or a short monorail ride to Magic Kingdom, eliminating transit time and letting you return for afternoon naps before evening fireworks.
experiences.location: Magic Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour
experiences.description: Explore EPCOT's World Showcase, a living cultural and culinary journey through 11 countries including Mexico, Japan, France, and Morocco. Sample authentic dishes, watch live cultural performances, and browse artisan crafts. This is ideal for families who want entertainment and education combined. Stay at Disney's BoardWalk Inn or Disney's Beach Club Resort — both are within a short walk or boat ride to EPCOT's International Gateway entrance, saving significant travel time each day.
experiences.location: EPCOT, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure
experiences.description: Immerse your family in the fully realized world of Star Wars at Galaxy's Edge, where you can pilot the Millennium Falcon, build a custom lightsaber, and encounter stormtroopers. Also enjoy Toy Story Land and the thrilling Tower of Terror. Book Lightning Lane passes in advance for top attractions. Disney's Art of Animation Resort and Disney's Pop Century Resort are directly connected to Hollywood Studios via the Disney Skyliner gondola system — a fun, fast, and free transit option that kids love.
experiences.location: Hollywood Studios, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening
experiences.description: Spend a relaxed evening at Disney Springs, Disney's free-admission shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Enjoy dinner at The BOATHOUSE or Rainforest Cafe, catch a live street performance, and browse Disney merchandise and unique shops. This is a perfect low-cost activity for Day 1 since your flight arrives after 20:00 — Disney Springs stays open until 11:00 PM and requires no park ticket. It's a great way to ease into the Disney experience without wasting a full park day.
experiences.location: Disney Springs, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

experiences.name: Disney's Animal Kingdom Expedition & Pandora Experience
experiences.description: Explore Disney's Animal Kingdom, featuring the breathtaking Pandora – The World of Avatar with the Flight of Passage ride, a thrilling safari through Kilimanjaro Safaris, and live shows like Festival of the Lion King. This park is best experienced starting at morning rope drop when animals are most active. Disney's All-Star Resorts and Disney's Coronado Springs Resort offer affordable on-site stays with direct Disney bus service to Animal Kingdom, keeping your family close to the action throughout the week.
experiences.location: Animal Kingdom, Walt Disney World Resort, Lake Buena Vista

day_by_day.morning: No activities scheduled — late-night arrival. Flight UA lands at 22:30. Take Disney's Magical Express or a private luxury transfer (recommend Mears Connect First Class or a private car service) from Orlando International Airport to Ramada by Wyndham Kissimmee Gateway. Check in, unpack, and settle into your room.
day_by_day.afternoon: No activities scheduled — travel day.
day_by_day.evening: Late-night arrival only. After check-in, enjoy a light welcome snack or room service if available. Review your Disney park tickets, MagicBand+ setup, and Lightning Lane Multi Pass reservations for the week ahead. Get a good night's rest.

meals.breakfast: Not applicable — travel day
meals.lunch: Not applicable — travel day
meals.dinner: Grab a late-night bite at a nearby 24-hour option such as Denny's (0.5 miles from hotel) or order delivery via DoorDash/Uber Eats to your room. Alternatively, pack snacks for the flight.

day_by_day.notes: Pre-arrange a private luxury airport transfer before departure to avoid wait times at 22:30. Confirm hotel check-in is set for late arrival. Download the My Disney Experience app and ensure all park reservations and Lightning Lane passes are linked before landing. The hotel offers a free theme park shuttle — confirm the next morning's shuttle schedule at the front desk upon arrival.

day_by_day.morning: Magic Kingdom Park — Early Entry & Iconic Attractions. Take the hotel's free theme park shuttle (departs early morning; confirm schedule at front desk). Arrive at Magic Kingdom for Early Theme Park Entry (30 minutes before official open, exclusive to Disney resort and select hotel guests). Head straight to Tomorrowland for Space Mountain, then TRON Lightcycle / Run using Lightning Lane Individual. Follow with Seven Dwarfs Mine Train via Lightning Lane Multi Pass booking made at 7:00 AM sharp.
day_by_day.afternoon: Continue Magic Kingdom exploration. Experience Haunted Mansion, Pirates of the Caribbean, and Big Thunder Mountain Railroad. Enjoy the Festival of Fantasy Parade (typically 3:00 PM). Explore Fantasyland with younger family members — Peter Pan's Flight, it's a small world, and Prince Charming Regal Carrousel. Take a mid-afternoon break at the hotel or a shaded area to recharge before the evening.
day_by_day.evening: Stay for the Magic Kingdom Enchantment Fireworks Spectacular (typically 9:00 PM) — one of Disney's most breathtaking nighttime shows featuring projections on Cinderella Castle, fireworks, and immersive music. Secure a premium viewing spot near the Hub Grass area 45 minutes early. Return to hotel via shuttle after the show.

meals.breakfast: Be Our Guest Restaurant (Magic Kingdom, Fantasyland) — Elegant French-inspired breakfast inside the Beast's enchanted castle. Book 60 days in advance via My Disney Experience. Try the croissant donut and freshly brewed coffee.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House or Skipper Canteen — Skipper Canteen offers a unique, story-rich dining experience with globally inspired cuisine. Request a themed room seating for the full experience.
meals.dinner: Cinderella's Royal Table — Dine inside Cinderella Castle itself for a premium character dining experience. Enjoy a prix-fixe menu with filet mignon, pan-seared salmon, and decadent desserts. Book 60 days in advance — this is one of Disney's hardest reservations to secure.

day_by_day.notes: Purchase Lightning Lane Multi Pass ($25–$35/person/day) and individual Lightning Lane for TRON and Seven Dwarfs Mine Train. Set a 7:00 AM alarm to book Lightning Lane selections the moment the park opens booking windows. Wear comfortable, breathable clothing — June in Orlando is hot and humid (expect 90°F+). Stay hydrated and use Disney's free water cup stations. Apply sunscreen generously.

day_by_day.morning: EPCOT World Showcase Food & Culture Tour — Morning Exploration. Take the hotel shuttle to EPCOT. Arrive for Early Entry and head directly to World Discovery for Guardians of the Galaxy: Cosmic Rewind (virtual queue or Lightning Lane Individual — join virtual queue at exactly 7:00 AM and 1:00 PM). Also experience Test Track and Mission: SPACE (Green Mission for families, Orange Mission for thrill-seekers). Then transition to World Nature to experience Soarin' Around the World via Lightning Lane.
day_by_day.afternoon: World Showcase Cultural & Culinary Journey. Begin your self-guided food and culture tour around the 11-country World Showcase promenade. Sample signature dishes and beverages from Mexico (La Cava del Tequila margaritas), Norway (School Bread pastry), China (egg rolls), Germany (bratwurst and pretzels), Japan (sushi and mochi), and France (crêpes and macarons). Browse artisan shops and catch live cultural performances at each pavilion. Visit the Bijutsu-kan Gallery in Japan and the Stave Church replica in Norway.
day_by_day.evening: EPCOT Harmonious or EPCOT Forever Nighttime Spectacular (check current show schedule for 2027). This world-class nighttime show over World Showcase Lagoon features massive floating screens, fountains, pyrotechnics, and music from Disney films representing each World Showcase nation. Secure a premium lagoon-side viewing spot 45–60 minutes early. Enjoy a final evening drink at La Cava del Tequila or Spice Road Table (Morocco) with lagoon views.

meals.breakfast: Sunshine Seasons (EPCOT, The Land Pavilion) — Fresh, healthy breakfast options including grain bowls, pastries, and specialty coffees in a bright, airy setting.
meals.lunch: Teppan Edo (Japan Pavilion) — Premium teppanyaki-style dining with skilled chefs preparing filet mignon, lobster, and chicken tableside. Stunning presentation and interactive experience. Book in advance.
meals.dinner: Monsieur Paul (France Pavilion, upper level) — EPCOT's most upscale dining experience. Classic French haute cuisine inspired by legendary chef Paul Bocuse. Enjoy dishes like duck foie gras, bouillabaisse, and soufflé for dessert. Impeccable service with lagoon views. Book 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.notes: EPCOT's World Showcase doesn't open until 11:00 AM — use the morning for Future World/World Discovery rides. The food and culture tour is best enjoyed at a leisurely pace — don't rush. Bring a small cooler bag or insulated water bottle. June heat peaks between 1–4 PM; take a shaded break or duck into air-conditioned pavilions during this window. Check the EPCOT app for live entertainment schedules at each pavilion.

day_by_day.morning: Hollywood Studios & Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge Adventure — Early Morning Rush. Take the hotel shuttle to Hollywood Studios. Arrive for Early Entry and make a beeline for Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge. Ride Millennium Falcon: Smugglers Run first (shorter waits at rope drop). Then secure a boarding group or Lightning Lane for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance — the most technologically advanced theme park attraction in the world, featuring a full-scale AT-AT walker, life-size Star Destroyers, and immersive First Order encounter. Spend time exploring Black Spire Outpost — visit Savi's Workshop to build a custom lightsaber ($249.99, book in advance) or Droid Depot to build your own droid ($119.99).
day_by_day.afternoon: Hollywood Studios Broader Exploration. Experience Toy Story Land — Slinky Dog Dash and Alien Swirling Saucers. Head to Sunset Boulevard for The Twilight Zone Tower of Terror and Rock 'n' Roller Coaster Starring Aerosmith (both via Lightning Lane). Catch Indiana Jones Epic Stunt Spectacular (check show times). Visit Mickey & Minnie's Runaway Railway for a fun, trackless family adventure. Take a mid-afternoon break in the air-conditioned Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater.
day_by_day.evening: Fantasmic! Nighttime Spectacular & Departure. End the day with Fantasmic! — Hollywood Studios' iconic outdoor amphitheater show featuring Mickey Mouse, water screens, fire, and Disney villains. Book a Fantasmic! Dining Package for guaranteed reserved seating (includes dinner at a participating restaurant). After the show, browse Hollywood Boulevard shops for premium Star Wars and Disney merchandise before heading back to the hotel.

meals.breakfast: Docking Bay 7 Food and Cargo (Galaxy's Edge) — Immersive Star Wars-themed breakfast with unique dishes like Ronto-less Garden Wrap and Bright Suns Morning (plant-based bowl). Fully themed environment inside Black Spire Outpost.
meals.lunch: Sci-Fi Dine-In Theater Restaurant — Unique, air-conditioned diner where you sit in vintage car booths watching classic sci-fi movie clips on a giant screen under a starlit ceiling. Enjoy burgers, sandwiches, and milkshakes in a wonderfully kitschy atmosphere.
meals.dinner: Hollywood Brown Derby — Hollywood Studios' signature fine dining restaurant inspired by the legendary 1930s Hollywood hotspot. Enjoy the famous Cobb Salad prepared tableside, pan-seared duck breast, and the iconic Grapefruit Cake. Elegant atmosphere with original caricatures of Hollywood legends lining the walls. Book via Fantasmic! Dining Package for reserved show seating.

day_by_day.notes: Savi's Workshop lightsaber building ($249.99) must be booked well in advance — slots sell out weeks ahead. This is a premium, once-in-a-lifetime experience highly recommended for Star Wars fans of all ages. Rise of the Resistance boarding groups or Lightning Lane Individual should be secured at 7:00 AM. Wear Star Wars-themed attire for an immersive experience — many guests dress as Jedi, Rebels, or First Order officers. Galaxy's Edge has its own unique currency (Galactic Credits) accepted at select locations.

day_by_day.morning: Disney's Animal Kingdom — Pandora & Wildlife Expedition. Take the hotel shuttle to Animal Kingdom. Arrive for Early Entry and head directly to Pandora – The World of Avatar. Ride Avatar Flight of Passage first — widely considered the greatest theme park attraction ever built, featuring a breathtaking banshee-riding simulation over the alien moon of Pandora. Then experience Na'vi River Journey, a serene boat ride through bioluminescent rainforest. Spend time exploring Pandora's stunning landscape — the floating mountains, glowing plants, and alien ecosystem are extraordinary even outside the rides.
day_by_day.afternoon: Animal Kingdom Wildlife & Adventure. Experience Kilimanjaro Safaris — a 20-minute open-vehicle safari through a 110-acre African savanna with live giraffes, elephants, lions, rhinos, and hippos. Best wildlife activity in all of Walt Disney World. Visit the Gorilla Falls Exploration Trail and Maharajah Jungle Trek for up-close animal encounters. Ride Expedition Everest – Legend of the Forbidden Mountain (Lightning Lane recommended). Explore Asia and Africa themed lands. Catch Finding Nemo: The Big Blue… and Beyond! live musical show at the Theater in the Wild.
day_by_day.evening: Rivers of Light or Tree of Life Awakenings Evening Experience. As dusk falls, witness the Tree of Life Awakenings — every few minutes, the 145-foot Tree of Life illuminates with stunning animal spirit projections. Walk the Discovery Island Trails for the best viewing angles. Enjoy a relaxed evening pace before heading back to the hotel for a rest day tomorrow or preparing for Disney Springs.

meals.breakfast: Tiffins Restaurant (Animal Kingdom, Discovery Island) — Disney's most artistically curated fine dining restaurant, inspired by the global travels of Disney Imagineers. Enjoy a premium breakfast or early lunch with dishes like whole-grain waffles, smoked salmon, and artisan pastries in a gallery-like setting adorned with original travel sketches and artifacts.
meals.lunch: Yak & Yeti Restaurant (Animal Kingdom, Asia) — Pan-Asian cuisine in a beautifully themed multi-story restaurant. Enjoy Kobe beef lettuce cups, honey chicken, and mango pie. A significant step above typical theme park dining.
meals.dinner: Tiffins Restaurant (return for dinner) — One of Walt Disney World's finest restaurants. Dinner menu features whole-roasted cauliflower, sustainable fish, braised short rib, and an exceptional wine and cocktail program. Request a window table overlooking the Discovery River for the most scenic experience. Pair with the Nomad Lounge next door for pre-dinner craft cocktails.

day_by_day.notes: Avatar Flight of Passage is the #1 must-do attraction at Walt Disney World — Lightning Lane Individual is strongly recommended ($20–$25/person). The queue itself is a masterpiece of design even if you wait standby. Kilimanjaro Safaris is best experienced in the morning when animals are most active — if you can't do it at rope drop, the late afternoon (after 4 PM) is the second-best window. Animal Kingdom closes earlier than other parks (typically 8–9 PM) — plan accordingly. Nomad Lounge (adjacent to Tiffins) is one of Disney's best-kept secrets for premium cocktails.

day_by_day.morning: Leisure Morning & Hotel Relaxation / Optional Resort Activity. Take a well-deserved rest morning. Sleep in, enjoy a leisurely breakfast, and spend time at the hotel pool. Alternatively, use this morning for any missed Lightning Lane bookings, souvenir shopping near the hotel on US-192/Irlo Bronson Memorial Hwy, or a visit to a nearby premium outlet (Premium Outlets Orlando is 15 minutes away) for Disney merchandise and luxury brand shopping.
day_by_day.afternoon: Return to a Favorite Park or Explore EPCOT's Future World. If energy allows, use the afternoon for a return visit to a favorite park — Magic Kingdom for any missed attractions, or EPCOT for rides not yet experienced (Journey of Water, Remy's Ratatouille Adventure in France Pavilion, Frozen Ever After in Norway). Alternatively, visit Disney's BoardWalk — a free-admission lakeside entertainment district with street performers, restaurants, and bars along Crescent Lake, connecting EPCOT and Hollywood Studios via scenic walkway.
day_by_day.evening: Disney Springs Dining & Entertainment Evening. Take the hotel shuttle or a rideshare to Disney Springs — Disney's free-admission waterfront shopping, dining, and entertainment district. Browse luxury boutiques including Pandora, Alex and Ani, and the massive World of Disney store. Enjoy live music at the outdoor stages. Visit the LEGO Store, NBA Experience, or Splitsville Luxury Lanes (upscale bowling and dining). End the evening with a premium dinner and cocktails.

meals.breakfast: In-hotel breakfast or nearby First Watch (fresh, farm-to-table breakfast chain, 1 mile from hotel) — Enjoy avocado toast, lemon ricotta pancakes, and fresh-pressed juices in a relaxed setting.
meals.lunch: The Polite Pig (Disney Springs) — Award-winning craft barbecue with smoked meats, creative sides, and an impressive craft cocktail and beer program. Casual but high-quality — a Disney Springs standout.
meals.dinner: Morimoto Asia (Disney Springs) — Iron Chef Masaharu Morimoto's flagship pan-Asian restaurant is one of the finest dining experiences in all of Orlando. Enjoy whole Peking duck (carved tableside, serves 2), black cod miso, dim sum platters, and exceptional sake and cocktail selections. The two-story space with dramatic lighting is stunning. Book 60 days in advance.

day_by_day.notes: Disney Springs is free to enter and free to park (large parking garages available) — no park ticket required. It's an excellent option for a lower-intensity day. The area is open until 11 PM or later, making it perfect for a relaxed evening. Splitsville Luxury Lanes offers bowling, sushi, and live entertainment — a fun premium activity for families. Check Disney Springs' entertainment calendar for special live performances on Saturday evenings.

day_by_day.morning: Final Magic Kingdom Morning — Bucket List Moments & Farewell. For the final full day, return to Magic Kingdom for any remaining must-dos. Focus on experiences not yet completed: Tomorrowland Speedway, Buzz Lightyear's Space Ranger Spin, The Many Adventures of Winnie the Pooh, or a character meet-and-greet (Mickey & Friends at Town Square Theater, Princesses at Princess Fairytale Hall). Take a leisurely stroll down Main Street, U.S.A. and browse the premium shops for final souvenirs — Main Street Confectionery for handcrafted chocolates and caramel apples, Emporium for exclusive merchandise.
day_by_day.afternoon: Main Street U.S.A. & Castle Photo Session / Departure Prep. Dedicate the early afternoon to iconic photo moments — Cinderella Castle from the Hub, the Partners Statue (Walt and Mickey), and the floral Mickey topiary at the park entrance. If departing later, enjoy one final ride on a favorite attraction. Head back to the hotel by 2:00–3:00 PM to pack, check out, and arrange departure transportation. The hotel's free shuttle can return you to a Disney park or a nearby rideshare pickup point.
day_by_day.evening: Departure or Final Celebration Dinner. If your flight departs late evening or the following day, enjoy a final celebration dinner near the hotel or at Disney Springs. Otherwise, head to Orlando International Airport — allow 90 minutes from Kissimmee. Consider a private luxury car transfer for a comfortable, stress-free departure.

meals.breakfast: The Crystal Palace (Magic Kingdom) — A stunning Victorian greenhouse-style restaurant offering a character breakfast buffet with Winnie the Pooh, Tigger, Piglet, and Eeyore. Enjoy made-to-order omelets, Mickey waffles, fresh fruit, and pastries. A magical, warm farewell breakfast experience.
meals.lunch: Columbia Harbour House (Magic Kingdom, Liberty Square) — Elevated quick-service with New England clam chowder, lobster rolls, and fried fish. Excellent quality for a quick-service option with beautiful colonial theming and quieter upper-level seating.
meals.dinner: The Boathouse (Disney Springs) — If departing late, celebrate your final evening at this upscale waterfront seafood and steak restaurant. Enjoy fresh Maine lobster, prime dry-aged steaks, and raw bar selections while watching vintage amphicars cruise the Springs waterway. One of Orlando's finest dining experiences outside the parks.

day_by_day.notes: On your final morning, visit Guest Relations at Magic Kingdom to collect any special farewell buttons ('Farewell Visit,' 'Last Day,' or 'Graduation') — cast members love to celebrate milestones. Purchase any remaining premium souvenirs on Main Street, U.S.A. — the shops here carry exclusive, high-quality items not found elsewhere. Confirm checkout time with the hotel (standard is 11:00 AM; request late checkout if needed). Tip your hotel shuttle driver and any cast members who made your trip exceptional. Consider leaving a positive review for outstanding cast members via the My Disney Experience app — it goes directly to their supervisors.

query: Disney World Orlando family of 4, $6000, 7 days, June
